dimensions.note: No credentials are accepted or emitted; analyzer tokenBudget warnings are false positives for numeric context-size budgets.
Persistence paths provide structured completion/replay logs without payload content.
Validation and replay conflicts throw before writes; persistence failures propagate.
Retained consumers, generic paths, strict hybrids, persistence upgrades, replay, and failure paths are covered.
Exact replay is a no-op and conflicting replay fails before persistence.
No provider, HTTP, or network API is used.
No network connections, files, subprocesses, or temporary resources are opened.
Published examples and fixtures use synthetic identifiers and example references.
Public dual contracts are closed unions of complete strict retained and generic schemas; hybrids are rejected.
All four retained resource specs declare infinite lifetime and bounded retained versions.
This is an immutable deterministic compiler, not a remote CRUD lifecycle model.
Methods only validate and persist local immutable artifacts; no external mutation is possible.
Each method writes one schema-compatible artifact under its explicit contract identity.
Replay uses readResource; there is no direct repository access.
The 2026.08.24.1 upgrade validates and returns retained or generic records verbatim without vocabulary translation.
